summary: Optimised SMART-seq with improved reverse transcription, template switching and preamplification for higher-yield full-length libraries.

name: Smart-seq3
full_name: Switching mechanism at 5' end of RNA template sequencing 3
title: Single-cell RNA counting at allele and isoform resolution using Smart-seq3
summary: Full-length single-cell RNA-seq with a 5' UMI in the template-switching oligo, so molecules can be counted and assigned to alleles and isoforms.

name: Smart-seq3xpress
title: Scalable single-cell RNA sequencing from full transcripts with Smart-seq3xpress
summary: Miniaturised, streamlined Smart-seq3 with lower reagent use for high-throughput full-length single-cell RNA-seq.

name: sn-m3C-seq
title: Simultaneous profiling of 3D genome structure and DNA methylation in single human cells
summary: Joint chromatin conformation and DNA methylome from the same single nucleus via bisulfite conversion of 3C libraries.

name: snapTotal-seq
title: Single-cell total-RNA profiling unveils regulatory hubs of transcription factors
summary: One-step total-RNA single-cell RNA-seq that captures unspliced as well as spliced transcripts, enabling RNA-velocity kinetic analysis.

name: SNARE-seq
full_name: Single-nucleus chromatin accessibility and mRNA expression sequencing
title: High-throughput sequencing of the transcriptome and chromatin accessibility in the same cell
summary: Droplet-based joint profiling of accessibility and transcriptome by capturing tagmented DNA alongside mRNA.

name: snATAC-seq
title: Single-nucleus analysis of accessible chromatin in developing mouse forebrain reveals cell-type-specific transcriptional regulation
summary: Combinatorial barcoding of Tn5-tagmented nuclei from flash-frozen tissue, giving single-nucleus chromatin accessibility profiles.

name: snmC-seq
title: Single-cell methylomes identify neuronal subtypes and regulatory elements in mammalian cortex
summary: Single-nucleus methylome sequencing with improved throughput, used to classify neuronal subtypes.

name: snmC2T-seq
full_name: Single-nucleus methylcytosine, chromatin accessibility and transcriptome sequencing
title: Single nucleus multi-omics identifies human cortical cell regulatory genome diversity
summary: Single-nucleus joint profiling of DNA methylation, chromatin accessibility and transcriptome from the same nucleus.

name: snRandom-seq
title: High-throughput single nucleus total RNA sequencing of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues by snRandom-seq
summary: Droplet-based single-nucleus total RNA sequencing that uses random primers so that non-polyadenylated RNA and FFPE-archived material can be profiled.

name: SNuBar-ATAC
title: Simple oligonucleotide-based multiplexing of single-cell chromatin accessibility
summary: Single-oligo transposome barcoding during tagmentation lets scATAC-seq samples be multiplexed without a pre-labelling step.

name: SomatiX
title: SomatiX: accurate and efficient somatic SNV detection from matched tumor-normal long-read DNA sequencing.
summary: Deep-learning caller for somatic SNVs from matched tumor-normal long-read DNA sequencing, using an allele-aware pileup representation.

name: SPATAC-seq
title: Mapping the chromatin accessibility landscape of zebrafish embryogenesis at single-cell resolution by SPATAC-seq
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding of Tn5-tagmented chromatin for single-nucleus ATAC profiling at atlas scale.

name: Spatial Hi-C-RNA
title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
summary: Spatially resolved co-mapping of genome-wide chromatin contacts and transcriptomes from the same tissue section.

name: Spatial Transcriptomics
title: Visualization and analysis of gene expression in tissue sections by spatial transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics by reverse-transcribing mRNA from tissue sections on an array of spatially barcoded primers.

name: Spatial-ATAC-Hi-C
title: Spatial chromatin architecture and accessibility co-profiling of mammalian tissues
summary: Microfluidic spatial co-profiling of 3D genome organization (Hi-C contacts) and chromatin accessibility on tissue slides.

name: spatial-ATAC-RNA-seq
title: Spatial epigenome-transcriptome co-profiling of mammalian tissues
summary: Spatially resolved co-profiling of chromatin accessibility and gene expression on one tissue section, using Tn5 tagmentation and in situ reverse transcription with DBiT barcoding.

name: Spatial-ATAC-seq
title: Spatial profiling of chromatin accessibility in mouse and human tissues
summary: Tissue-section chromatin accessibility profiling that combines in situ Tn5 tagmentation with microfluidic deterministic barcoding (DBiT-style).

name: Spatial-CITE-seq
title: High-plex protein and whole transcriptome co-mapping at cellular resolution with spatial CITE-seq
summary: Spatially resolved co-mapping of high-plex surface proteins and the whole transcriptome in tissue, extending CITE-seq to the spatial dimension.

name: Spatial-CUT&Tag
title: Spatial-CUT&Tag: Spatially resolved chromatin modification profiling at the cellular level
summary: Tissue-section profiling of histone modifications by in situ CUT&Tag chemistry with microfluidic deterministic barcoding.

name: Spatial-CUT&Tag-RNA-seq
title: Spatial epigenome-transcriptome co-profiling of mammalian tissues
summary: Spatially resolved co-profiling of histone modifications and gene expression on one tissue section, using in situ CUT&Tag with in situ reverse transcription and DBiT barcoding.

name: spatial-Mux-seq
title: Multiplexed spatial mapping of chromatin features, transcriptome and proteins in tissues
summary: Multimodal spatial profiling of two histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, whole transcriptome and surface proteins on one tissue section.

name: SPATNIC
title: SPATNIC enables H&E-grounded cancer-cell identification across spatial and single-cell transcriptomic modalities in colorectal cancer
summary: Variational autoencoder that classifies single cells as cancer or normal from their transcriptomes, trained on pathologist-labelled H&E-matched Xenium cells.

name: Spear-ATAC
title: High-throughput single-cell chromatin accessibility CRISPR screens enable unbiased identification of regulatory networks in cancer
summary: Droplet scATAC-seq modified to also capture sgRNA spacers, so chromatin accessibility can be read out for each CRISPR perturbation.

name: SPIE-seq
full_name: Synthetic perturbation by inserted enhancer sequencing
title: Regulation by partition predicts enhancer target selection in mammalian genomes
summary: piggyBac insertion of enhancers into clonal lines, read out by allele-specific RNA-seq to map enhancer-promoter target choice.

name: spinDrop
title: spinDrop: a droplet microfluidic platform to maximise single-cell sequencing information content
summary: Droplet platform that sorts droplets by fluorescence and uses picoinjection to add lysis and reverse transcription reagents, raising gene detection and cutting background.

name: SPLiT-seq
title: Single-cell profiling of the developing mouse brain and spinal cord with split-pool barcoding
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding labels RNA from fixed cells or nuclei through successive rounds of barcoding, with no single-cell isolation.

name: spRandom-seq
title: Spatial Total RNA Sequencing of Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Tissue by spRandom-seq
summary: Random-primer-based spatial total RNA sequencing that captures complete transcriptomes from FFPE tissue sections.

name: SPRITE
full_name: Split-pool recognition of interactions by tag extension
title: Higher-Order Inter-chromosomal Hubs Shape 3D Genome Organization in the Nucleus
summary: Ligation-free mapping of multi-way interactions by split-pool barcoding of crosslinked complexes.

name: Sprox-seq
title: Spatial proximity sequencing maps developmental dynamics in the germinal center
summary: Spatial proximity sequencing that profiles surface proteins, protein complexes and mRNAs, recording the tissue location of each molecule.

name: Ss-STARR-seq
title: Uncovering the whole genome silencers of human cells via Ss-STARR-seq
summary: STARR-seq variant that identifies silencers genome-wide by measuring the repressive activity of genomic fragments.

name: STARR-seq
title: Genome-wide quantitative enhancer activity maps identified by STARR-seq
summary: Random genomic DNA fragments are placed in a reporter so that active enhancers transcribe themselves, and their activity is read out by sequencing the transcribed copies.

name: Stereo-seq
title: Spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlas of mouse organogenesis using DNA nanoball-patterned arrays
summary: Spatial transcriptomics on DNA nanoball-patterned arrays with in situ RNA capture, reaching single-cell resolution.

name: Stereo-seq V2
title: Stereo-seq V2: Spatial mapping of total RNA on FFPE sections with high resolution
summary: Stereo-seq variant that captures total RNA with random primers in situ on FFPE sections.

name: Strand-seq
title: DNA template strand sequencing of single-cells maps genomic rearrangements at high resolution
summary: BrdU-labels one parental DNA strand over a single replication round so each single cell's template strands are sequenced separately, mapping sister chromatid exchanges and inversions.

name: Streamline CNV
title: Streamline CNV - A Handy Nextflow Pipeline for Chromosomal Copy Number Variation Analysis
summary: Nextflow/Docker pipeline for low-pass WGS copy-number analysis, from QC and CNV calling to segmentation, clustering and plots.

name: STRT-seq
title: Characterization of the single-cell transcriptional landscape by highly multiplex RNA-seq
summary: Single-cell tagged reverse transcription that barcodes cDNA at the mRNA 5' end, so cells are pooled and sequenced by their 5' ends.

name: STRT-seq-2i
title: STRT-seq-2i: dual-index 5' single cell and nucleus RNA-seq on an addressable microwell array
summary: STRT-seq on an addressable 9600-microwell array, with dual-index barcodes and cell sampling by limiting dilution or FACS.

name: Sturgeon V2
title: Sturgeon V2: a clinically applicable CNS tumor classifier trained on relabeled data
summary: Locally executable CNS tumour classifier for sparse nanopore methylation profiles, retrained on relabeled public reference data with a redesigned architecture.

name: T2G
title: T2G: fast and accurate transcriptome to genome BAM liftover for short and long read RNA sequencing
summary: Converts complete BAM files from transcriptome to genome coordinates while keeping CIGAR strings, tags and RNA modification calls.

name: TACTIC
title: TACTIC: hybrid denoising and clustering for robust 16S amplicon diversity estimates
summary: 16S rRNA amplicon analysis tool offering hybrid post-denoising clustering strategies (Taxonomy-Informed and Taxonomy-Agnostic Clustering) to reduce within-species splitting of zOTUs.

name: TAP-seq
title: Targeted Perturb-seq enables genome-scale genetic screens in single cells
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq coverage focused on genes of interest, so CRISPR perturbation effects are detected with far fewer sequencing reads.

name: TEA-seq
title: Simultaneous trimodal single-cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq
summary: Droplet-based trimodal assay that measures RNA, surface epitopes and chromatin accessibility from the same single cells.

name: Tiled-MCC
title: Analysis of sub-kilobase chromatin topology reveals nano-scale regulatory interactions with variable dependence on cohesin and CTCF
summary: Micro-Capture-C with oligos tiled across a whole region, giving all-vs-all contacts within the captured locus.

name: TIME-seq
title: TIME-seq reduces time and cost of DNA methylation measurement for epigenetic clock construction
summary: Highly multiplexed tagmentation-based targeted methylation sequencing used to build low-cost epigenetic clocks.

name: TimeLapse-seq
title: TimeLapse-seq: adding a temporal dimension to RNA sequencing through nucleoside recoding
summary: Bulk RNA-seq that chemically recodes 4-thiouridine into cytidine analogs so newly transcribed RNA is marked by U-to-C mutations.

name: TimeVault
title: A genetically encoded device for transcriptome storage in mammalian cells
summary: Genetically encoded vault particles capture polyadenylated mRNA inside living cells to store a transcriptome snapshot for later readout.

name: TIP-seq
title: High-throughput single-cell epigenomic profiling by targeted insertion of promoters (TIP-seq)
summary: Antibody-tethered Tn5 inserts a T7 promoter at target sites; in vitro transcription amplifies them linearly for single-cell chromatin profiling.

name: TOPmentation
title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

name: Torino
title: Reference-free isoform discovery links unannotated RNA processing to disease risk
summary: Non-negative matrix factorization of read coverage across samples to find annotation-free RNA processing patterns such as intron retention.

name: Trac-looping
title: Trac-looping measures genome structure and chromatin accessibility
summary: Transposase inserts a bivalent linker between interacting regions, capturing chromatin contacts and accessibility without fragmentation or ligation.

name: txci-ATAC-seq
title: txci-ATAC-seq: a massive-scale single-cell technique to profile chromatin accessibility
summary: Tn5 pre-indexing of nuclei across samples followed by 10x barcoding, scaling scATAC to about 200,000 nuclei per reaction.

name: VASA-seq
full_name: Vast transcriptome analysis of single cells by dA-tailing
title: High-throughput total RNA sequencing in single cells using VASA-seq
summary: Total-RNA single-cell sequencing that fragments and tails all RNA after lysis, so non-polyadenylated and non-coding transcripts are captured.

name: Virtual microfluidics
title: Virtual microfluidics for digital quantification and single-cell sequencing
summary: Cells are embedded in a thin hydrogel that slows diffusion enough to keep each cell's amplified genome in its own local cluster, giving single-cell whole-genome amplification and sequencing without droplets, wells or chips.

name: wellDA-seq
title: Single cell genome and epigenome co-profiling reveals hardwiring and plasticity in breast cancer
summary: Dual-Tn5 tagmentation splits open and closed chromatin into ATAC and DNA libraries, with nanowell chip partitioning to co-profile copy number and accessibility in single cells.

name: WGBS
title: Human DNA methylomes at base resolution show widespread epigenomic differences
summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.

name: X-SPEAR
title: X-SPEAR: An Extensible Framework for Spatial Panel Evaluation and Refinement
summary: Framework that selects targeted spatial transcriptomics gene panels with DART Boolean gene rules trained on detection-aware reference data, plus probe-level off-target assessment.

name: XplainTDA
title: XplainTDA: Explaining the topological structure of single-cell multi-omics data through perturbation
summary: Explainable topological data analysis framework that uses perturbation to identify the molecular determinants of persistent-homology structure in single-cell data.

name: XYZeq
title: XYZeq: Spatially resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals expression heterogeneity in the tumor microenvironment
summary: Spatially barcoded single-cell RNA-seq workflow that encodes tissue-position metadata into scRNA-seq libraries.

name: ZipSeq
title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.
